findings.finding: The production patch applies the requested timezone context to both business-day helpers. All four patches have identical production content: addBusinessDays parses with options?.in and differenceInBusinessDays normalizes both inputs with that context before counting calendar days. Passing no context preserves the original paths.
evidence: A fresh public replay matched the captured bundle final digest; the frozen trial seed matched its seed digest.
code-kb skeleton/body review of both production functions on the fresh replay showed the context passed at the input-construction/normalization boundary, before weekday and calendar-day logic.
All four bundles have the same before/after SHA-256 values for both production files; their only production changes are those two parameter additions.

findings.finding: The added tests cover timezone-local midnight boundaries in Singapore and New York, forward and backward business-day shifts, full workweeks and zero offsets, input forms, reversed difference order, weekend transitions, and a daylight-saving boundary. Each patch’s added test files pass independently.
